title: IR and Raman spectroscopy reveal amino acid–surface interactions on B- and N-doped hydroxylated graphene quantum dots: a DFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7550-7563
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00110F, Paper
Open Access

Berke Özgür Arslan, Mine Yurtsever
DFT-calculated Raman spectra and structures of B/N-doped GQDs with and without OH functionalization. OH groups strongly modify the D- and G-band analogues (∼1200–1700 cm−1), indicating enhanced vibrational coupling and symmetry breaking.
